summary: Iter 81 — Disparo IA backend fully validated via 9 pytest cases (catalog, KPIs, ACL, list, generate-validation, approve full e2e with DB shape, reject, 404 detail). Frontend UI loads with sidebar 'Disparo em Massa' visible; data-testid attributes are present in code for all required elements (mass-tab-manual, mass-tab-disparo_ia, disparo-ia-panel, disparo-generate-btn, disparo-kpi-dashboard, disparo-filter-*, disparo-sug-{id}, disparo-sug-modal, disparo-msg-edit, disparo-briefing-edit, disparo-approve-btn, disparo-reject-btn). LLM generate endpoint not invoked to save budget (per agent-to-agent note).

minor.issue: read_rate is a proxy of delivery_rate (same value) because Meta Cloud read status isn't piped yet — note in code; not a bug but document for users.
When approving, code re-queries audience twice (calls _resolve_audience then runs raw subscribers query) — works correctly but duplicate work.

ui_bugs.issue: window.confirm string template-literal on approve() has mismatched quote terminator: backtick opens on L287, raw '"' embedded, '+' tokens inside the template literal end up rendered LITERALLY in the confirm dialog (cosmetic only — does NOT crash, JS parses it as one template string).

issues: 10th KPI card 'Cost / conv.' shows literal em-dash placeholder — fine for v1 but mark as 'em breve' visibly, not just in title tooltip.

action_items: (LOW) Fix the cosmetic quote mismatch in DisparoIaPanel.js approve() confirm() template literal (lines 285-288).
(OPTIONAL) Decouple read_rate from delivery_rate by reading mass_recipients.status='delivered' vs 'read' (if/when Meta read receipts are stored).
(OPTIONAL) Remove duplicate audience-resolution work in approve handler (use the result from _resolve_audience instead of re-querying).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/disparo_ia.py L223 has unused alias import `from services.disparo_ai import _resolve_audience as _ra  # noqa` — remove dead code.

services/disparo_ai.py compute_kpis uses POSITIVE_RE/NEGATIVE_RE without accent-stripping client replies — 'não' is captured but variants like 'nao tenho' rely on no-accent path; current pattern is reasonable but consider unidecode for robustness.
DisparoIaPanel.js approve() confirm string mishap (see ui_bugs).
approve handler accepts schedule_at as raw string (no ISO validation) — invalid input would only fail at start time.

success_rate.frontend: code-level OK; runtime not fully validated due to networkidle wait timeouts in playwright (app has continuous polling). All required data-testid attributes confirmed present in source.

seed_data_creation: Tests seed disparo_suggestions docs with TEST_ prefix in titles and clean them up in finally blocks; one mass_campaigns + mass_recipients created during approve test is also deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract for /api/disparo-ia is rock-solid. test_iter81_disparo_ia.py is a good regression seed — re-runs cleanly. Did NOT invoke /generate-suggestions (LLM-heavy, 10-20s, main agent already verified). For full E2E UI, use page.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded') instead of 'networkidle' — this app polls in background and never reaches networkidle. Sidebar link 'Disparo em Massa' is in the left nav under 'Inteligência' section.
rca of the issue: n/a — no blocking bugs found. The single LOW priority frontend issue is a JS template-literal quote mismatch in the confirm() dialog of DisparoIaPanel.js which causes the dialog text to render with stray '+' and '"' tokens but does NOT throw.
